original_test_intent: Verify BMC I2C-6 reaches UPHY0 through first-PG548 mux0x71 port0 by observing the approved PID1114953 downstream replies, not merely the mux address or an invented physical probe.
original_method: Confirm I2C-6-to-bus5 and first-PG5480x71 topology; capture ownership and the original mux byte; approve/select port0 with0x01; run exact PID-defined UPHY0 transactions; compare expected replies/errors; restore the original byte and confirm UPHY1/other channel and BMC health.
manual_activity: BMC/platform owner supplies PID mapping, exclusive-access window, expected UPHY0 replies and exact restoration; physical probing/photos are not elevated to core coverage absent a separate decision.
required_inputs: PID1114953 first-PG548 mux0x71 port0 UPHY0 address/reply matrix
Proof logical BMC I2C-6 equals i2c-tools bus5
Mux register semantics for0x01, allowed combined bits and pre/post expected values
Bounded downstream commands with exit/reply/NACK/timeout criteria
Original-state restore and independent BMC recovery plan
safety_requirements: Validate exact bus/mux/endpoints before any write
Do not force access while a driver/daemon owns0x71
Record original byte and preserve unrelated enabled channels rather than assuming0x01 replacement is safe
Abort on NACK, timeout, arbitration loss, stuck bus or management degradation
Restore exact state and verify port2/UPHY1 plus management services
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only identity, topology, ownership and mux-state baseline
After approval, perform one bounded port0 selection plus exact downstream reads and restoration
Never probe/solder, guess mapping/address, scan blindly, leave mux changed, reset BMC, retry danger automatically or decide DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve raw write, exclusivity, abort/recovery and restoration
Resolve any separately desired physical evidence

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Incorrect physical-only substitution; the source explicitly supplies BMC commands.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: With approvals, preserve `i2cget -f -y 5 0x71` and `i2ctransfer -y 5 w1@0x71 0x01`, add only PID-defined UPHY0 reads and restore the recorded byte.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BMC, bus5, mux0x71, port0/value0x01, first PG548, UPHY0, PID1114953 and 15/5-minute scope retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Execute a controlled mux0x71 port0 functional transaction with downstream UPHY0 reply validation and exact restoration.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds measurable replies, ownership control and cleanup while rejecting unsupported mandatory probing.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Mux0x71 readback alone cannot establish UPHY0 reachability, and prior port2/UPHY1 evidence cannot cover port0.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Raw writes may drop other mux channels or disrupt BMC daemons; digital replies do not characterize physical signal margin.

project_override_considerations: Wistron I2C rules require BMC/platform-management ownership, bus/address/OOB mapping and expected response before execution.
expected_evidence: BMC identity, tools version, bus ownership and health baseline
Original mux byte, approved0x01 selection/readback and interpretation
Timestamped expected-versus-observed downstream reply matrix and exit status
Bus/error logs plus proof unrelated mux channels remain healthy
Exact restore/readback, UPHY0/UPHY1 and BMC service health, engineer verdict
